notes: Cover-image research pass for the 38 published Russian universities whose cover_image_url is empty, completed 2026-09-16. Method: Wikimedia Commons and ru.wikipedia were queried through the MediaWiki API from node (a descriptive bot User-Agent was used; curl --data-urlencode mangled Cyrillic in this Git-Bash environment, so all API calls were made from node fetch). For each institution I searched Commons in Russian and English (list=search, namespaces 6|14), enumerated the matching Commons category with prop=imageinfo/extmetadata to read licence, author, description and pixel dimensions, and cross-checked the ru.wikipedia article lead image (prop=pageimages) as an independent identification signal. Every sourceUrl is an upload.wikimedia.org direct file URL with any utm_* query string stripped, and every one was re-requested this session until it returned an image/* content-type (HTTP 200, or 206 on a ranged retry after Wikimedia 429 rate-limiting). Ambiguous candidates were downloaded and visually inspected before being accepted or rejected. Where no Commons asset existed I fell back to the institution’s own domain with a browser User-Agent; no .ru site in this batch published a usable og:image or campus hero, and several are dead or relocated. No uploads, database writes or publishes were performed. Caveats for the reviewer: (1) chelyabinsk-state-medical-university is the institution now named South Ural State Medical University; the image is correct for the institution but the record name is historic, and the July 2026 pass already flagged this rename as an unresolved identity issue. (2) moscow-region-state-university-medicine has likewise been renamed Государственный университет просвещения. (3) amur-state-medical-academy: the July 2026 pass found its registered domain amursma.ru hijacked into a casino affiliate site; the cover proposed here comes from Commons and is unaffected, but the record’s website field still needs review. (4) mechnikov-north-western-medical-university is a campus sports facility rather than the main academic block, the only free exterior available on Commons. (5) Several entries deliberately use the parent university’s main building for the "(Medical Institute/Faculty)" records; this is stated explicitly in each rightsBasis. (6) petrozavodsk-state-university is licensed under the Free Art License rather than Creative Commons.

entries.reason: Wikimedia Commons searched in Russian ("Чувашский государственный университет", "ЧувГУ", "Чувашский государственный университет имени Ульянова здание") and English. Category:Chuvash State University holds only four files: two group photographs of students (identifiable people in frame), File:P9012019-2.jpg and File:Здание Чебоксарского медицинского техникума.jpg. I downloaded and visually inspected both building shots. P9012019-2.jpg is captioned only "Чебоксары, проспект Ленина, 6" and the visible facade signage reads "СТРОИТЕЛЬНЫЙ..." (a construction organisation), so it does not demonstrably depict ChuvSU. The second file is used as the ru.wikipedia lead image for Чувашский государственный университет имени И. Н. Ульянова and is category-tagged to the university, but its own title and description name a DIFFERENT institution ("Здание Чебоксарского медицинского техникума", the Cheboksary medical technical school), so the identification conflicts with itself. Official route: https://www.chuvsu.ru/ returns HTTP 200 but exposes no og:image or twitter:image and its homepage image set is entirely theme icons and logos under /wp-content/themes/ and /wp-content/uploads/ with no campus photograph. Holding rather than shipping a building that may belong to another institution.
